name: Onida Electronics Limited
summary: Onida Electronics Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of electronics and consumer durables in India. The company offers LED, LCD, and colour televisions; air conditioners; washing machines; microwave ovens; refrigerators; mobile phones; air cooler; LED light speaker system; and HD media player products under the Onida brand. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as MIRC Electronics Limited and changed its name to Onida Electronics Limited in May 2026. Onida Electronics Limited incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
